property_summary: For any caller and any beneficiary, supplyTokenTo credits the issued savings credits to the designated beneficiary and never to the caller's own imBalances entry when the caller is a fresh address; the mutant credits msg.sender instead, so a fresh caller's imBalances becomes nonzero for any amount >= 1 with caller != beneficiary.
change_summary: Credit the caller's own balance instead of the designated beneficiary's balance.
